msgBox.sierra.body: macOS is running this app from a temporary, randomized location because it still has a "downloaded from the internet" flag. This can confuse auto-detection of your openFrameworks path.
msgBox.sierra.easyFix: just set the OF path below to the folder containing "addons" and "libs".
msgBox.sierra.permanentFix: close this app, move ProjectGenerator.app anywhere via Finder (e.g. to your Desktop) and back, then relaunch.
